summary: Capital Bancorp filed an 8-K on September 29, 2026, disclosing a definitive Agreement and Plan of Merger under which Capital will merge into Peoples Bancorp, with Peoples surviving; Capital Bank then merges into Peoples Bank. Capital holders receive 1.11 shares of Peoples common stock per Capital share, a fixed-exchange-ratio all-stock deal with cash for fractional shares. Both boards unanimously approved. Capital equity awards accelerate, options cash out at the spread and performance awards vest at target. The parties intend tax-free reorganization treatment. Watch the shareholder vote, regulatory approvals and any deal spread relative to Peoples stock.
